book.name: Zon tokbaut Zizas
book.title: Zon tokbaut laip ane tising blo Zizas

content: Lazaras i bin ded
I bin gad wan man neim Lazaras ane em bin sik. Em i bin stap lo tu sisi blo em, Meri ane Mata wea da biliz neim Betani.
Dis Meri, em da seim oman nau uda i go rabe da BosLod Zizas wea sentoil antap lo leg blo em ane waipe tu leg blo em wea eya blo em. Wa, Meri i sisi blo dis seim Lazaras uda i sik.
Demtu sisi i bin sane mesiz po Zizas diskain, ‘BosLod. Da wan uda yu prapa labem, i prapa sik.’

Wen Zizas i bin lisen da mesiz, em bin spik, ‘Lazaras kan ded prom dis sik, bikoz plenti pipol i go luk da paua blo God ane ol go liptemap neim blo em. Dempla i go luk paua blo mi tu ane go liptemap neim blo mi tu, bikoz ai da Boi blo God.’
Nomata Zizas i bin prapa labe Mata, Meri ane Lazaras,
em no bin go stretwei go po luk dempla. Em bin stap wea dat ples wea em bin stap po nada tu dei.
Wen tu dei i bin pas nau, em bin spik po dem klostuman blo em, ‘Kam, yumpla go nau, gobaik po Zudia.’
Dem klostuman i spik baigen, ‘Tisa. Dem nada dei de go, dem pipol i bin wande stone yu po ded. Kole, ane yu wande gobaigen de nau a?’

Zizas ansa dempla diskain, ‘I gad tuelb aua blo deilait wea deitaim. Solong i gad lait ol pipol i go wagbaut seipwan, wa, dempla nogo bang wea samting ane poldaun bikoz dempla i gad da lait blo dis wold.
Mata wea naittaim, dempla i go bang ane poldaun bikoz i nogad no lait.’
Den em spik diskain po dempla, ‘Gud pren blo yumpla Lazaras, em i slip. Ai go go ane weikemapem.’
Dem klostuman i spik demkain, ‘BosLod, ip em i slip, em go kam orait!’
Dem klostuman i bin tingk Zizas bin min demkain Lazaras i bin kasa leidaun slip, bat Zizas i bin min Lazaras i bin ded.
Den Zizas i eksplein po dempla kliawei, ‘Lazaras i ded.
Ane po yupla, ai glad ai no bin de wea Lazaras. I demkain solong yupla i go mata bilib wea mi. Bat nomata em ded, kam, yumpla go nau po luk em.’
Tomas bin spik nau. Plei neim blo em i Tuin. Tomas i spik po dem nada klostuman diskain, ‘Kam, yumpla go tu solong ip dempla go kile Zizas dempla go kile yumpla tu.’
Wen Zizas i bin kesem de, em bin luk Lazaras i ded, leidaun insaid wea wan greib insaid keib po po dei.
Da biliz blo Betani i bin klostu po Zarusalem, baut tri kilamita.
Plenti ol Zuwispipol i bin kam de po Mata ane Meri po sidaun krai po meke demtu pil orait bikoz bala blo demtu i bin ded.
Wen Mata i bin lisen Zizas i kam de, em bin stretwei go po luk Zizas. Bat Meri i bin mata de wea dat aus gar.
Mata i spik diskain po Zizas, ‘BosLod ip yu bin ya, mai bala i no bin ded.
Bat ai prapa sabe ya wea diskaintaim, wanem yu prea aske God po mekem, wa, em go mekem po yu.’
Zizas spik po Mata, ‘Bala blo yu i go gedap laipwan gen.’
Mata i ansa Zizas diskain, ‘Ai prapa sabe wea dat lasdei bambai, ebri pipol i go gedap laipgen prom ded.’
Zizas i bin spik po Mata, ‘Ai da truwan blo meke ol ded pipol kamlaipgen, ai da truwan po gibe laip. Enibodi uda i mata bilib wea mi, nomata dempla i go ded, dempla go kamlaipgen.
Dempla go gede longlaip poeba po bilib lo mi. Dempla nogo ded po gud. Mata, yu bilib dem tok ya ai spik a?’
Mata i bin ansa, ‘Wa, BosLod. Ai mata bilib yu da Promiswan, da Boi blo God wea i go kam po dis wold.’
Den Mata bin lego gobaik ane singaut Meri. Em spik po Meri diskain wea kuaiatwei solong nobodi i go lisen, ‘Da Tisa bin kam ane em bin spik mi po spik yu po go de po em.’
Stretwei Meri i bin go po luk Zizas.
Zizas i no bin go insaid da biliz blo Betani. Em bin mata weit de wea da ples wea Mata i bin kam po luk em.

Wen dem pipol uda i bin sidaun de wea aus, i bin luk Meri i bin ariapwan go ausaid, dem pipol i bin tok midel demplaselp diskain, ‘Ei, ei! Em mas go po sematri po krai de wea da keib wea i gad da greib blo Lazaras.’ So dempla i bin go tu go biain.
Wen Meri i bin kam luk Zizas stanap de, em bin poldaun wea put blo em ane bin spik diskain po em, ‘BosLod, ip yu bin ya mai bala no bin ded.’
Wen Zizas i bin luk Meri i bin krai, prapa sore po bala blo em ane luk dem pipol i base prapa bigkrai tu, Zizas i bin pil nadakain sore ane atso.
Zizas i spik, ‘Wea yupla bin bere em?’ Dempla ansa, ‘BosLod, yu kam gar ane luk.’
Zizas i bin krai tu.
Dem pipol uda i bin stanap klostu i bin spik, ‘Prapa truwan gar, em bin prapa labe Lazaras.’
Bat sam prom dem pipol i bin spik, ‘Em bin meke wan blainman po luk. Aukam em no bin stape Lazaras prom ded?’
Zizas bin meke Lazaras laipgen prom ded
Zizas bin nadakain sore ane atso. Em bin kam nau po da greib. Da greib i bin insaid wea wan keib ane i bin gad big ston i bin kaba da doa blo da keib.
Zizas i bin spik, ‘Yupla puse da ston go wansaid.’ Mata, sisi blo Lazaras, i bin spik po Zizas, ‘BosLod, diskaintaim nau bodi blo em i smel nadakain nugud. Diswan i da namba po dei em bin leidaun.’
Bat Zizas i bin spik po Mata, ‘Ai bin spik yu de pas, ip yu go mata bilib, yu go luk da prapa bigpaua blo God.’
So dempla i bin puse da big ston prom da greib doa go wansaid. Zizas bin luk go antap po eben ane prea diskain ya, ‘PapaGod, ai eso yu gar. Yu bin pinis lisen po wanem ai wandem.
Ai prapa sabe yu oltaim lisen po wanem ai wandem. Ai tok laudwan diskain solong dem pipol ya i go lisen ane ol go mata bilib yu bin sane mi kam.’
Wen Zizas i bin pinis prea, em bin spik prapa laudwan diskain ya, ‘Lazaras! Kamaut! Kam ausaid nau!’
Ane Lazaras i bin kamaut, kam ausaid wea beriolklos kaba ebribodi blo em, pes blo em tu.
Dem pipol wande kile Zizas
Plenti pipol uda bin de wea Meri, dempla i bin bilib wea Zizas wen ol bin luk lo ai wanem Zizas bin mekem.
Bat sam dem pipol i bin go ane spik po dem Parasi baut wanem Zizas i bin mekem.
Dem edprist ane dem Parasi ol bin kam tugeda meke wan Zuwiskaunsil miting. Ol bin spik, ‘Wiswei? Wanem yumpla i go mekem nau? Dis man i meke ol tumas mirikalsain apen.
Ip yumpla i mata lete em po mekem wanem em i wandem, wa, tumas pipol i go bilib wea em. Da Rom gabman i go kam ane damiz dis Tempol ya blo yumpla ane tekoba dis kantri blo yumpla.’
Wan prom dempla, neim Kaiapas, i bin da Zuwis bosprist dat iya. Em spik demkain po dempla, ‘Yupla prapa nogad no sens.
Ken yupla luk wanem i go apen ya? I gobi mobeta po yumpla po meke wan man po ded po ebri pipol den po meke ebri Zuwispipol po pinis.’
Bikoz Kaiapas i bin da bosprist dat seim iya, dis tok blo em i no bin tok blo em, bat i bin kam prom God. Em bin tok diskain, ‘Zizas i go ded po dem Zuwispipol.
Bat i nogo mata ded po dem Zuwispipol, bat em go ded wantaim wea diswei ya po meke ebri pipol blo dis wold po kambaigen tugeda po bi wan pipol blo God.’
So prom da miting blo dem Zuwislida, dempla bin stat po meke plan po sote laip blo Zizas.

Prom datting nau Zizas nomo bin go po bizit ol ples wea ol dem Zuwispipol ane miks wea dempla. Em i bin libe Zarusalem ane em bin go po wan ples wea i nogad pipol. Diswan i klostu po da biliz blo Ipreim, so Zizas i bin stap de nau wea dem klostuman blo em.

Taim blo da Pasoba Pestabol blo dem Zuwispipol i bin kam klostu nau ane tumas pipol i bin kam prom ol ausaid ples, kam pas po Zarusalem bipo da pestaboldei i stat. Ol i mekem demkain solong po meke laip blo dempla kam rait prant wea God, bipo da Pasoba Pestabol.
Dempla ebriwan i bin wande luk Zizas. Ol bin tok po wananada diskain wen ol bin stanap de wea da Tempol blo God. ‘Wiswei yupla tingk? Em go kam po dem dei blo da Pasoba Pestabol, o no?’
Bat dem edprist ane dem Parasi bin meke wan oda po dem pipol, ip enibodi i sabe wea Zizas, em mas spik solong dempla go grabe Zizas ane lokem wea zeilaus.
